items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: at Kelly's Stables -- I remember once at Kelly's Stables Coleman Hawkins was in there... all of them were in that -- in Kelly's Stables that one time.

ctx.x: You mentioned Errol Garner was there. How about Linton Garner? Was he there too in New York then too?

No, he wasn't there then. He wasn't there then. He wasn't -- Slam Stewart was down there then, though. He was playing off 52nd Street. And Basie with his big band, he used to work down there at the Famous Door -- how they got them up there, I'll never know, man, but they sure used to rock

that place, man, and they took up half the room. The band took up almost -- those rooms, you got to remember, they never did seat over 75, 80, 85 people, hardly any of those rooms in there, because about a 14 piece band in there, you know, it's some guy -- the piano was down on the floor. You had to have that down there, and you had all the guys -- I guess that's why they sounded good. They all were concentrated right together, like up in a little nook or something like that. And they sounded real good.
